exceptions.rationale: Bundled SQLite before 3.54.0 can return uninitialised page-cache memory when it opens a crafted database and -wal pair with mismatched page sizes. The SQLite adapter opens only the operator-configured database path, which the service creates and writes itself; exposure needs a less trusted party to plant both files at that path. No patched path exists yet: sqlx-sqlite 0.9.0, the latest, requires libsqlite3-sys <0.38 and the fix is in >=0.39.0. Retire when sqlx ships a release that allows 0.39.
